name: Cargo Jettison System
description: A pilot or system operator can dump any single cargo bay, or all cargo, as a swift action. Noticing it from another starship takes a DC 30 Perception or Use Computer check made as a reaction.
effect: A pilot or system operator can dump any single cargo bay, or all cargo, as a swift action. Noticing it from another starship takes a DC 30 Perception or Use Computer check made as a reaction.

legacy.effect: Can jettison cargo as swift action

name: Cargo Pod, Light
description: Adds (the starship's cost modifier) x 1 tons of cargo. Each pod added reduces the starship's Dexterity by 2 (a pod cannot be added if it would drop Dexterity below 1). A pod can be made detachable, to act as an escape pod, for five times the cost.
effect: Adds (the starship's cost modifier) x 1 tons of cargo. Each pod added reduces the starship's Dexterity by 2 (a pod cannot be added if it would drop Dexterity below 1). A pod can be made detachable, to act as an escape pod, for five times the cost.

name: Cargo Pod, Medium
description: Adds (the starship's cost modifier) x 5 tons of cargo. Each pod added reduces the starship's Dexterity by 2 (a pod cannot be added if it would drop Dexterity below 1). A pod can be made detachable, to act as an escape pod, for five times the cost.
effect: Adds (the starship's cost modifier) x 5 tons of cargo. Each pod added reduces the starship's Dexterity by 2 (a pod cannot be added if it would drop Dexterity below 1). A pod can be made detachable, to act as an escape pod, for five times the cost.

name: Cargo Pod, Heavy
description: Adds (the starship's cost modifier) x 10 tons of cargo. Each pod added reduces the starship's Dexterity by 2 (a pod cannot be added if it would drop Dexterity below 1). A pod can be made detachable, to act as an escape pod, for five times the cost.
effect: Adds (the starship's cost modifier) x 10 tons of cargo. Each pod added reduces the starship's Dexterity by 2 (a pod cannot be added if it would drop Dexterity below 1). A pod can be made detachable, to act as an escape pod, for five times the cost.

name: Cloaking Device, Hibridium
description: The starship has total concealment and may always make a Stealth check to sneak (a -10 penalty applies to notice it). While active it also treats all other targets as having total concealment, and those aboard cannot see out.
effect: The starship has total concealment and may always make a Stealth check to sneak (a -10 penalty applies to notice it). While active it also treats all other targets as having total concealment, and those aboard cannot see out.

legacy.effect: Invisible to sensors, but distorts sensor readings nearby

name: Cloaking Device, Stygium
description: The starship has total concealment and may always make a Stealth check to sneak (a -10 penalty applies to notice it). Noticing it does not negate the concealment but allows attacks against it with the normal concealment penalty.
effect: The starship has total concealment and may always make a Stealth check to sneak (a -10 penalty applies to notice it). Noticing it does not negate the concealment but allows attacks against it with the normal concealment penalty.

name: Cryogenic Chambers
description: Each unit carries (the starship's cost modifier)/5 Medium or smaller creatures in stasis; Large creatures take five times as much space and Huge creatures twenty times.
effect: Each unit carries (the starship's cost modifier)/5 Medium or smaller creatures in stasis; Large creatures take five times as much space and Huge creatures twenty times.

name: Docking Clamps
description: Lets the starship dock with other starships in space; smaller ships can stay clamped through maneuvers, combat and hyperspace. If the ship takes damage exceeding its damage threshold, every starship attached by a docking clamp is shaken off.
effect: Lets the starship dock with other starships in space; smaller ships can stay clamped through maneuvers, combat and hyperspace. If the ship takes damage exceeding its damage threshold, every starship attached by a docking clamp is shaken off.

legacy.effect: Can dock with and carry 1 smaller vessel

name: Droid Repair Team
description: Deploys automatically when the starship moves -1 or more steps down the condition track, making one Mechanics check (modifier +13) to jury-rig it up 1 step. If damage gets past SR while the team is active there is a 25% chance it is destroyed.
effect: Deploys automatically when the starship moves -1 or more steps down the condition track, making one Mechanics check (modifier +13) to jury-rig it up 1 step. If damage gets past SR while the team is active there is a 25% chance it is destroyed.

name: Escape Pod, Small Lifeboat
description: Small lifeboats (ships of Colossal (frigate) size or larger): life support for fifteen Medium creatures for up to 1 week. One bay holds (the starship's cost modifier)/50 lifeboats; multiple bays may be installed.
effect: Small lifeboats (ships of Colossal (frigate) size or larger): life support for fifteen Medium creatures for up to 1 week. One bay holds (the starship's cost modifier)/50 lifeboats; multiple bays may be installed.

name: Escape Pod, Large Lifeboat
description: Large lifeboats (ships of Colossal (cruiser) size or larger): life support for up to 50 Medium creatures for up to 2 months, with a class x15 hyperdrive for one jump. One bay holds (the starship's cost modifier)/100 lifeboats; multiple bays may be installed.
effect: Large lifeboats (ships of Colossal (cruiser) size or larger): life support for up to 50 Medium creatures for up to 2 months, with a class x15 hyperdrive for one jump. One bay holds (the starship's cost modifier)/100 lifeboats; multiple bays may be installed.

name: Extended Range
description: Improves the starship's consumables by 10% of the original value (rounded down, minimum 1 day) for each time it is installed.
effect: Improves the starship's consumables by 10% of the original value (rounded down, minimum 1 day) for each time it is installed.

name: Hangar Bay
description: Ships of Colossal (frigate) size or larger. Each bay has (the starship's cost modifier)/50 units of hangar space (Huge craft take 1 unit, Gargantuan 5, Colossal 20); a vehicle enters or exits with two move actions.
effect: Ships of Colossal (frigate) size or larger. Each bay has (the starship's cost modifier)/50 units of hangar space (Huge craft take 1 unit, Gargantuan 5, Colossal 20); a vehicle enters or exits with two move actions.

name: Hangar Bay, Concealed
description: As a hangar bay, but recognizing a concealed bay from outside takes a DC 30 Perception check (a thorough internal search finds it), and entering or exiting takes two full rounds.
effect: As a hangar bay, but recognizing a concealed bay from outside takes a DC 30 Perception check (a thorough internal search finds it), and entering or exiting takes two full rounds.

legacy.effect: 1 concealed hangar space, DC 25 Perception to detect

name: Transceiver, HoloNet
description: Real-time audio, visual and holographic communication over unlimited range, and (with a hypertransceiver) the only way to contact a ship in hyperspace. Use Computer checks to gain information with it get a +5 equipment bonus. During the Galactic Empire its availability is Military.
effect: Real-time audio, visual and holographic communication over unlimited range, and (with a hypertransceiver) the only way to contact a ship in hyperspace. Use Computer checks to gain information with it get a +5 equipment bonus. During the Galactic Empire its availability is Military.

name: Transceiver, Hyper
description: Effectively unlimited-range communication (with time lag) and access to HoloNet information in reduced detail; one of the only means of contacting a ship in hyperspace.
effect: Effectively unlimited-range communication (with time lag) and access to HoloNet information in reduced detail; one of the only means of contacting a ship in hyperspace.

name: Luxury Upgrade, Basic
description: Shipwide accommodation upgrade. Maintaining it costs 1/50 of its price each month, or the luxury level drops one step.
effect: Shipwide accommodation upgrade. Maintaining it costs 1/50 of its price each month, or the luxury level drops one step.

name: Luxury Upgrade, Extreme
description: Shipwide accommodation upgrade. Maintaining it costs 1/50 of its price each month, or the luxury level drops one step. An extreme upgrade raises the ship's crew quality by one step (maximum expert), with no effect on a crew of heroes.

name: Medical Suite
description: Ships of Colossal (frigate) size or larger. Includes (the starship's size modifier)/5 medical beds and (the starship's size modifier)/50 bacta tanks; a medical bed counts as a medpac (10 uses), a medical kit and a surgical kit.
effect: Ships of Colossal (frigate) size or larger. Includes (the starship's size modifier)/5 medical beds and (the starship's size modifier)/50 bacta tanks; a medical bed counts as a medpac (10 uses), a medical kit and a surgical kit.

legacy.description: Full medical facility with bacta tank.
legacy.effect: +2 to Treat Injury checks, can perform surgery

name: Passenger Conversion, Seating
description: One section holds a number of passengers equal to the ship's size modifier, with seats (typically for voyages of a day or less); steerage-quality accommodations.

name: Slave Circuits, Basic
description: Reduces the starship's crew requirement by 1/3 (never below 1). Crew quality is still based on the remaining crew.

name: Slave Circuits, Recall
description: Requires advanced slave circuits. The starship can be summoned by comlink and will lift off, fly to the comlink and land, taking no other actions. Crew quality under recall control is untrained, and anyone at the pilot position can disable it as a swift action.

name: Transponder, IFF
description: A blank IFF transponder that can be switched on or off as a swift action. With the right codes the ship appears as a friend; without them a Use Computer check can be tried against the enemy ship (Will Defense 15 + its Intelligence modifier, starting attitude unfriendly, DC +10).
